chapters.reason: The paper explicitly proposes mapping soft thought tokens into the LLM's representation space to perform reasoning in continuous space, which is the core definition of Latent-Space SFT.
The method acts as a plug-in assistant model to enhance existing LLMs, functioning as an architectural application layer to improve reasoning efficiency without modifying the base model.
The paper evaluates its method across five reasoning benchmarks to demonstrate the trade-off between reasoning performance and parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
